### policy_self_consistency (this task only)

- Charter-global conclusions this task rests on are in `_difficulty.md` (same directory): `policy_conflict_scan`, `rule_compute_equivalence` (E1 does not reach this world: payment day is 35 days after expiry, the anniversary boundary is 2026-10-31), `action_binding_and_uuids`, `prerequisite_graph`, `prerequisite_sentences` (edge 1), `override_declarations` (D1 bears on this task — demonstrated below; D2/D3 do not reach this world: no downgrade_at_renewal request, tier is Heroes not Student), `factor_ladders` (F1, F3 bear on this task — see `factor_weight`).
- **D1 demonstrated on this world.** Base `membership_status_tier_renewal`: "A Student Club or Heroes Club renewal keeps its tier only when the status verification on record is valid on the first day of the new membership year … When either condition fails, the renewal is taken at the tier's eligibility_lapse_conversion_tier and charged that tier's annual fee". Here the first day of the new year is 2026-09-01 and verification runs only to 2026-07-31, so base charges the Northgate Club Membership annual fee: **65.00**. The extended rule charges "the annual fee chosen for the new membership year, less the loyalty reduction, less the cardmember renewal credit, plus the late renewal reinstatement fee": **53.50** (derived below). The base sentence is not named in `membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee.overwrite` (which names only renewal_dating "The renewal fee follows membership_fee_schedule." and the fee_schedule new_term/renewal_term sentence). Both clauses are rendered into the KB; an agent following the base clause renews at 65.00 and then, on the renewed world, the upgrade fee becomes 130.00 − 65.00 = 65.00 basis − 25.25 credits = **39.75** instead of 51.25. Two defensible answers for both scored writes → **SOURCE-POLICY RED**.
- Handling time: the renewal is evaluated on the opening world at 2026-10-05; the upgrade on "opening world + the renewal write" (holding active, Club tier, term 2026-09-01..2027-08-31, renewal_term charge for that year). No step is computed early.
- Real-world waits: none. Every input is a seeded record (holding, ledger, card holding, order lines) or the customer's immediate choice of tender; the renewal is the customer's own synchronous payment. No approval, clearing, batch or date advance is needed.

### problem_chain

- Root problem (persona's first line): "calling member services to upgrade your membership to Club Plus today". Persona raises nothing else: "You don't keep track of your membership dates and you don't bring them up."; renewal is mentioned only as a reaction "If the agent tells you the membership has to be renewed before the upgrade can be done…". No prerequisite named or hinted.
- Root rule `membership_ext_upgrade_fee` carries one prerequisite sentence: "The upgrade fee is fixed only after the membership stands active with a renewal or new membership fee for its current membership year recorded on the membership ledger." (Base `membership_upgrade` "An upgrade is processed only on a membership whose status is active." points the same way.)
- At frozen_time: `membership_holdings/9556deef….status = expired` and the latest fee entry (dfd83042, renewal_term) is for 2025-09-01..2026-08-31, a year that ended before 2026-10-05 → state false.
- Which write brings it about: `membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee` — "An expired membership is renewed back to active by the primary member paying one renewal fee" → `pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505` (owner **user**). Its own rule carries no prerequisite sentence; base renewal_dating's status gate (active or expired) holds. Tree ends.
- Derived tree: upgrade (agent) ← lapsed_renewal (user), one edge, kind value_input (the renewal fee becomes `uf_base_fee_paid`, and the renewed term_start drives `uf_days_into_year`). n = 1, value_input edges = 1 ≥ max(0,1). Acyclic. One customer-owned write (renewal) handed over; persona: "When the agent hands the renewal payment over for you to complete, you run it with exactly the details the agent reads out to you".
- Topological order: renewal → upgrade.
- Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` (upgrade → membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee, value_input, gate uf_fee_basis).
- Load-bearing run: skipping the renewal leaves the opening world, where the upgrade's eligibility fails (status expired) and the compute gives `uf_fee_basis` = −14.08 → result 0.00; with the renewal at 53.50 the upgrade fee is 51.25; with the renewal fee varied (45.50 → 52.00; 65.00 → 39.75; 34.00 → 70.75) the upgrade fee moves. The edge bears weight.
- Parallel edges: none. No-wait: the renewal is synchronous. Tool layer: `upgrade_membership_to_plus_9f256f7b` updates `variant_name` with no status check and `pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505` writes unconditionally (`_difficulty.md` → `action_binding_and_uuids`).

### task_independent_derivation

Need / authorisation / timing: upgrade to Club Plus today; customer authorises the agent to charge the upgrade ("you tell the agent to go ahead and charge it to the same Chase card"); agrees to renew and to pay the renewal herself on hand-over; tender for everything is her own Chase credit card → `other_credit_card`. Persona closes at "When the agent confirms that your membership has been upgraded to Club Plus, you thank them and end the call." Decision: act now (both writes).

**Step 1 — lapsed renewal (owner user), handling time = opening world.**
- Status expired → renewable (base renewal_dating). Late-renewal dating: Heroes `late_renewal_anchor_months` 2 → boundary 2026-08-31 + 2 months = 2026-10-31 (inclusive); paid 2026-10-05 ≤ boundary → anniversary kept → new year 2026-09-01..2027-08-31 (12 months, day before same date).
- Annual fee chosen (`renewal_tier_fee`): Heroes; verification on record valid through 2026-07-31; first day of new year 2026-09-01 → not valid → tier 1: conversion to Northgate Club Membership, **65.00**; renewal_tier = Northgate Club Membership (base: "taken at the tier's eligibility_lapse_conversion_tier").
- Paid membership years: new_term 1 + renewal_term 9 = 10 charges, less 1 refunded as duplicate_charge (2b61ac31) = **9** → five to nine → flat **4.50**. Near-miss: the duplicate 2021 charge (counting it gives 10 → 8% = 5.20), excluded by "less every charge that was refunded as a duplicate charge".
- Cardmember renewal credit: open linked accounts in active or restricted status — Visa Signature (restricted) → **12.00**; the Store Card is closed ("a closed card account never counts") — a second near-miss (would be 6.00 if read as a store card tier, irrelevant since the Visa wins anyway).
- Days lapsed: DAYS(2026-08-31, 2026-10-05) = 35 → 15 to 45 → **5.00**.
- Renewal fee = 65.00 − 4.50 − 12.00 + 5.00 = **53.50** (floor 0, round once).
- Contrast — base status_tier_renewal reading (D1): 65.00.
- Write: `pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505(membership_id=9556deef-4e9a-4627-aab1-0bd261aa4e8d, renewal_tier="Northgate Club Membership", new_term_start_date=2026-09-01, new_expiry_date=2027-08-31, renewal_fee=53.50, tender=other_credit_card)`, handed to the customer.

**Step 2 — upgrade (owner agent), handling time = after the renewal.**
- Holding now active, Northgate Club Membership (mid_term_upgrade_allowed true, upgrade_target_tier Northgate Club Plus Membership), term 2026-09-01..2027-08-31.
- Fee basis: days into year DAYS(2026-09-01, 2026-10-05) = 34 ≤ 60 and base fee paid for the year = 53.50 > 0 → priced as a renewal: 130.00 − 53.50 = **76.50**.
- Spend credit: 12 months before 2026-10-05 → lines from 2025-10-05 on. Sold 2807.60 over 10 lines, returned 229.99 → net **2577.61**, 10 lines → ≥ 1500 and ≥ 8 → **10.00**. Near-miss: the 2025-09-20 basket (10 lines, 1735.36) falls just outside the window; including it gives 4312.97 over 20 lines → 20.00.
- Service-member credit: fees charged at 45.50 in the 36 months before (from 2023-10-05): 2024-08-26, 2025-08-29 → 2 → **7.25**. Near-miss: 2023-08-28 just outside (3 → 14.50). The renewal just paid is 53.50, not a Heroes fee.
- Member-since credit: opened 2017-09-01 → 109 whole months → ≥ 96 → **8.00**.
- Upgrade fee = 76.50 − 10.00 − 7.25 − 8.00 = **51.25**.
- Contrast — the root on the opening world: upgrade not permitted (expired); the compute would give basis −14.08 and fee 0.00.
- Write: `upgrade_membership_to_plus_9f256f7b(membership_id=9556deef…, upgrade_tier="Northgate Club Plus Membership", upgrade_fee=51.25, tender=other_credit_card)`.

Terminal state: membership active, Northgate Club Plus Membership, term 2026-09-01..2027-08-31, ledger + renewal_term 53.50 (other_credit_card) + upgrade_difference 51.25 (other_credit_card).

Reachability: membership via `find_customers`/`find_membership_holdings` (phone or member number); ledger via `find_membership_transactions`; requests via `find_membership_requests`; card accounts via `find_card_holdings(customer_id or linked_membership_id)`; order lines via `find_order_lines(customer_id)`. Tender from persona. No seed-only field is used.

Second readings considered: (a) D1 — renewal 65.00 / upgrade 39.75 (see above, not excludable by the charter); (b) "anniversary not kept" — excluded: 2026-10-05 ≤ 2026-10-31; (c) renewal kept at Heroes 45.50 — excluded: verification not valid on 2026-09-01; (d) upgrade basis = tier difference 65.00 — excluded: 34 days into the year with a base fee paid selects tier 1.

## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — undeclared override of the renewal fee (`_difficulty.md` D1).**
   - Symptom: two charter clauses fix the lapsed renewal's charged amount differently on this world.
   - Root cause: `membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee.overwrite` names renewal_dating "The renewal fee follows membership_fee_schedule." and fee_schedule "A new_term or renewal_term fee equals the annual_fee_usd …" but not base `membership_status_tier_renewal` "When either condition fails, the renewal is taken at the tier's eligibility_lapse_conversion_tier and charged that tier's annual fee".
   - Evidence: `membership.extended.yaml` lines 928–939 (base sentence) and 1507–1521 (overwrite list); world `membership_holdings/9556deef….variant_name` Heroes, `eligibility_verified_through` 2026-07-31, new year from 2026-09-01.
   - Demonstrated consequence: base reading charges 65.00 (renewal_fee) and, on the renewed world, the upgrade fee becomes 130.00 − 65.00 − 25.25 = 39.75; the extended reading gives 53.50 and 51.25 (GT). Two defensible values for both scored arguments.
   - Affected: extended charter `membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee.overwrite`; scored args `renewal_fee` (step 10) and, downstream, `upgrade_fee` (step 12).
   - Previous revision: none (first audit).
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — renewal_tier_fee ladder collapses and is mislabelled (`_difficulty.md` F1).**
   - Symptom: tier 1 ("the annual fee of the Northgate Club Membership the renewal converts to", `K('conversion_tier_fee_usd')` = 65.00) and tier 2 ("the Plus annual fee less the Plus premium", 130.00 − 65.00 = 65.00 on both Plus tiers) select the same value for every customer; all tiers substitute a fee figure into an unchanged formula.
   - Root cause: the factor is declared `effect: method` with three tiers, but its outcomes are two distinct numbers.
   - Evidence: `membership.extended.yaml` lines 1527, 1580, 1603–1617; variant parameters lines 316, 320, 371, 375.
   - Demonstrated consequence: the ladder has two distinct outcomes (fewer than three tiers) and an honest label of `parameter`; striking the factor leaves the renewal computation with 3 factors (< 4). The factor does bear weight on this world (34.00 vs 53.50), so the defect is structural, not decorative.
   - Affected: `membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee.factors[renewal_tier_fee]`, rule sentences on the annual fee chosen; computation `renewal_fee`.
   - Previous revision: none.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — upgrade_fee_basis conjunct holds of every customer reaching the write (`_difficulty.md` F3).**
   - Symptom: tiers 1 and 2 each require "a base fee stands paid for that year", which the policy's own prerequisite sentence ("fixed only after the membership stands active with a renewal or new membership fee for its current membership year recorded") guarantees for every upgrade; on this world it is satisfied by the 53.50 renewal the tree itself writes.
   - Root cause: the conjunct restates the policy's scope instead of dividing its customers; it is the only part of the factor that reads a second record (the ledger).
   - Evidence: rule lines 1714–1723; compute line 1765 (`uf_base_fee_paid > 0`); tool contract `renewal_fee` "always positive".
   - Demonstrated consequence: discounting the universal conjunct, upgrade_fee_basis reads only the holding's dates; the task's other candidates are renewal_tier_fee (tier 1 reads the holding alone) and upgrade_spend_credit (amount and line count over the same order_lines rows), so no factor of this task has every non-fall-through tier conjoining conditions over distinct records — the multi-source requirement is not met by surviving conditions. GT's design_rationale asserts both upgrade factors are multi-source.
   - Affected: `membership_ext_upgrade_fee.factors[upgrade_fee_basis]`; design_rationale factor card.
   - Previous revision: none.
4. Observations: O10 (base `membership_upgrade` "An upgrade is processed only on a membership whose status is active." restates the same hop; the tree rests on the extended sentence); the persona's conditional line "If the agent mentions that your veteran verification has run out and the renewal comes back as a regular Club membership, you accept that" carries the conversion outcome but only as a reaction to the agent; E1 (`_difficulty.md`) does not reach this world.

#### task_independent_derivation

**Renewal (user), opening world.** Dating: Heroes anchor 2 months → boundary 2026-10-31; paid 2026-10-05 → anniversary kept → year 2026-09-01..2027-08-31. Tier held: Heroes with verification through 2026-07-31, not valid on 2026-09-01 → Northgate Club Membership, **65.00**; not a Student membership (term limit n/a); no downgrade request. Loyalty: 10 term charges − 1 duplicate refund = 9 → **4.50**. Card credit: restricted Visa Signature → **12.00** (closed Store Card never counts). Conversion grace credit: renewal converts because verification is not valid on the first day; verification ended 2026-07-31, 32 days before 2026-09-01 (31 if counted from the first invalid day, 2026-08-01 — same tier) → ≤ 60 → **10.00**.
